perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: The September 18 FDA full approval of Inluriyo plus Verzenio remains the newest material Lilly primary disclosure located, converting Phase 3 evidence into a commercializable oncology combination for ESR1-mutated ER+/HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer after endocrine progression.

The September 15 EASD preview adds near-term cardiometabolic readout visibility across Foundayo, retatrutide and eloraTZP, but scheduled presentations remain evidence-to-come rather than realized commercial execution.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Approval is a real regulatory execution conversion; commercial contribution still depends on uptake, eligible population, reimbursement and competitive positioning.
Upcoming EASD data may refine pipeline expectations, but should not be pre-counted before the actual data are released and interpreted.

unknowns: actual EASD eloraTZP Phase 2 efficacy/safety results

sources.use: near-term expectations and pending evidence calendar

lineage.searchStrategy: fresh issuer-domain verification plus expectations-calendar check; pending data not treated as realized evidence
